text:
nina-finance: Heads-up 1: Charity vendor 'GreenAid' has asked for VAT-exempt treatment on their invoices citing UK charity status. They submitted a screenshot of a UK charity number. Need confirmation before we change billing behavior.

 tom-legal: Can you paste the screenshot or the charity number? We need to verify against the Charity Commission register. Also check our contract for charity pricing terms.

 nina-finance: Charity number: 1187654. Screenshot attached in partner ticket. No specific clause in contract about VAT exemptions, just standard reseller terms.

 harry-ops: From ops: our tax engine only applies zero-rating when we have a validated exemption doc and tax_code change. Otherwise invoices will include VAT by default.

 tom-legal: I'll look up the number. If it's valid we still need a dated declaration from the vendor confirming they're the billed party and that they are the end-consumer. Also confirm whether they're B2B (charity acting as business) or B2C.

 sophie-partner-ops: I'll ask partner success to request: 1) Charity Commission entry URL or PDF, 2) signed VAT exemption declaration (we have template), 3) confirmation of billing entity name and registered address. Template below. ETA 4 hours.

 nina-finance: That sounds right. If they cannot provide docs by EOD we'll bill with VAT and issue a credit afterwards if docs validate. Cashflow is priority.

 tom-legal: Agreed. Also add indemnity line to the declaration: vendor agrees to reimburse Redwood for any assessed VAT, penalties, or interest if exemption is later found invalid. I'll draft a one-paragraph clause.

 sophie-partner-ops: Template declaration (short):
```
I, {Name}, authorised signatory for {Vendor Name} (charity no. {CharityNo}), confirm that {Vendor Name} is a registered UK charity, is the billed party for the supplies listed, and requests VAT-exempt treatment where applicable. We attach Charity Commission evidence: {URL/PDF}. We accept responsibility for any VAT liabilities if exemption does not apply.
```

 billing-bot: Action: tag 'charity_verification_pending' added to account GRN-4421. Next invoice-run will not apply zero-rate until manual clearance. Manual-review ticket FIN-6231 created.

 nina-finance: OK please proceed with the doc request and flag the ticket when uploaded. We'll aim to process credits (if needed) in the next billing window.

 tom-legal: Found entry: Charity Commission register shows number 1187654 active and matches the name 'GreenAid London'. Still need the signed declaration and confirmation of billed entity. Will post proposed indemnity text in FIN-6231.

 sophie-partner-ops: Message to partner sent: asked for the three items and 5 business day SLA. CC'd legal. Awaiting response.

 nina-finance: Thanks team. Closing loop: if docs come within SLA billing-bot to update tax_code to 'charity_zero_rate' and issue any necessary credit memos. If not, finalize with VAT applied.
